top_signals.title: S&P 500 Targets Record as Bonds Climb and Oil Dips: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The S&P 500 is set to move closer to its first record high since August in a broad advance in global stocks as bonds climbed and weaker oil prices helped ease worries over inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Moonshot Said to Eye Early 2027 IPO After Value Hits $50 Billion
top_signals.summary: Moonshot AI has closed the final round of private fundraising at a valuation of about $50 billion and is heading toward an initial public offering in Hong Kong in the first quarter of next year, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The era of ‘easy money’ is over, warns Carmignac boss
top_signals.summary: Star stockpicker Edouard Carmignac has urged investors to stop buying into passive funds as rising interest rates signal the end of ‘easy money’. The veteran fund manager, who co-founded asset management house Carmignac in 1989, warned investors that staying in passive funds risks exposure  to struggling, debt-heavy companies. top_signals.title: Hong Kong officials double down on end-2026 deadline for crypto licensing bill
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong regulators plan to establish a licensing regime for four categories, including digital asset trading, custody, advisory and management services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
